admission: The released gRPC caller version is admitted only through a verified signed selection; candidate and caller identity fences refuse experimental generations.

surfaces.http: Existing authenticated exact Caller Map, progress and citation routes

required_inputs: either a repository-root generated-from-snapshot.json (t20-generated-from-v1) mapping the generated client file to its declaration
or protoc-gen-go output beside the protoc-gen-go-grpc client whose embedded descriptor equals exactly one committed .proto at its source path
the .proto declaration and the generated Go client committed at the same revision
excluded: generated code whose .proto is not committed
generated code built from a .proto that has since changed
several equivalent committed copies of the same .proto
YARPC, Connect and other non-gRPC protobuf clients
gRPC calls through struct fields declared in another file
limits: At most 4,096 *.pb.go candidates per catalog within the existing generated-source and input blob bounds; decoded descriptors at most 4 MiB; all other bounds unchanged; no new measured capacity or SLO.
